title: Edit and run a multi-file project in the browser
description:
As the student, I want to create files, edit them, and run the project.

Feature: Web IDE
  Scenario: Create and run a two-file C++ project
    Given the student opens the IDE
    When they create main.cpp and util.cpp and press Run
    Then the terminal pane shows the program output
  Scenario: Projects persist
    Given a saved project
    When the page is reloaded
    Then the files are still there

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deployed; waiting on real sign-in and a real multi-file run.

right_now_summary: The web IDE is deployed, but real sign-in and multi-file runs still need testing.
